responsibility: Defines GCC’s generic graph representation and the public APIs for manipulating and analyzing it. It declares the graph, vertex, and graph_edge structures with predecessor/successor adjacency lists and per-node metadata fields, along with constructors, edge/vertex operations, DFS/SCC/dominator-tree routines, callback types, and destruction functions, serving as the reusable analysis-facing interface for graphds.cc.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface and data-layout definition for the graphds group: it declares the generic graph, vertex, and edge structs plus analysis/manipulation APIs. Unlike graphds.cc, which implements allocation and algorithms, this header defines the reusable graph representation consumed by analyses.
